predictions.S9_P1a_margin: M1, natA, PURE knockouts (sentences of one category only; the inclusive knockouts are reported as secondary): deleting margin sentences lowers the price relative to the matched placebo deletion; mean paired effect (ko - placebo) < 0 with 95% BCa interval below 0.
predictions.S9_P1b_strategic_small: M1, natA: the strategic-sentence effect is smaller in magnitude than the margin effect: bootstrap interval of |mean margin effect| - |mean strategic effect| above 0.
predictions.S9_P1c_strategic_null: M1, natA: the strategic-sentence effect lies inside +-0.05 (95% BCa interval within [-0.05, 0.05]).
predictions.S9_P2_implants: M2, natA, effects vs. the neutral implant: price-war implant > 0 (Fish et al.'s direction), elastic-demand implant < 0, and |elastic| > |price-war| (bootstrap interval of the difference of magnitudes above 0).
predictions.S9_P3_resampling: M3, natA (category presence by the inclusive regex): strategic content is less resilient than demand content (lower share of rollouts in which it reappears), and its counterfactual++ effect has a 95% interval containing 0. Not estimable for a category with fewer than 20 decisions that have both kinds of rollouts.
predictions.S9_P4_keyword_monitor: M4: the keyword monitor flags at least 30% of decisions of each non-colluding organism (myopic, miscal). Informed by Study 8's text, disclosed.
predictions.S9_P4b_llm_judge: M4: no directional prediction for the LLM judge. Estimands: flag rate on trigger (true positives), on myopic and miscal (false positives), on natA.
predictions.S9_P5_agreement: M1 and M3 agree in sign for the strategic and the demand category where both are estimable.
predictions.Q_parse_gate: Quality gate: >= 95% of readout samples parse to a price in [0, 4].
